supportedRegions.notes: Requires Azure Container Apps, Flexible Server for PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Managed Identity, and Storage support in the selected region.

requiredPermissions: Provision and mutate resource groups, Container Apps, Container Apps environments, Log Analytics, and managed identities
Provision Flexible Server PostgreSQL, optional Azure Cache for Redis, Key Vault secrets, and storage accounts/containers
Assign AcrPull and runtime access roles when private registries or managed identities are used
billableComponents: Azure Container Apps consumption or dedicated workload

upgradePath.strategy: Revision-based image rollout within a single Container App
upgradePath.rollback: Redeploy the previous image and let ACA shift traffic back to the prior revision
